# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want the tasks that belong to no story audited, so that the audit covers the whole board

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** the 10 tasks that belong to no story audited
**So that** the audit covers the whole board, not only what hangs off an epic

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given each of these 10 tasks, when it is read, then it matches the
      task template, meets the writing standard, and its claims hold
      against the code as it is now (#318 covered #173, #177, #234; #317
      covered #227, #262, #263, #264, #265, #266, #267)
- [x] Given each criterion, when it is read, then it names a test, a CI
      step or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date (fixed by
      #318 and #317 wherever it was missing)
- [x] Given each task, when its `## No parent` section is read, then it
      states a real reason, not a placeholder (#227's reason was inside an
      invisible HTML comment; #317 made it plain text)
- [x] Given each task, when its metadata is read, then it carries one type
      label, one priority label and an assignee (all 10 did already)
- [x] Given a task that turns out to belong under an existing story, when
      that is found, then it is re-parented and the finding recorded (none
      of the 10 needed it; each no-parent reason held up)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 3

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
7 of the 10 are the audit's own tooling, written during epic #251. They
were audited to the same standard as everything else.

`develop` → `main` merge (required on Story closure) is blocked: the
merge pulls in `backend/movie-service` test changes already on `develop`,
and the pre-commit compile gate needs a JDK 25 toolchain this sandbox
does not have (same gap #238 documents; no toolchain auto-download
repository is configured). `develop` carries this Story's changes; the
merge is pending a run with that toolchain available.
